chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from Ali ibn Hisan al-Wasiti, from al-Hasan ibn Yunus, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir, the freed slave of Abu Ja'far, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

regarding the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: (the nature made by Allah is which He has made men for). He replied: Divine Unity, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and Ali is the Commander of the Faithful.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Fitrat Allah in the context of Tawhid and Imamate?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Tawhid*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates that the primordial *Fitrah* mentioned in Surah Ar-Rum is not merely abstract monotheism, but specifically encompasses the triad of Tawhid, Nubuwwah (Prophethood of Muhammad), and Imamah (Imamate of Ali). This interpretation underscores the Shia doctrinal view that recognizing the divine authority of the Ahl al-Bayt is an innate, essential component of the human disposition towards God, rather than a later addition to faith.
